_status: ILLUSTRATIVE generic FAO values, not locally calibrated. Added for user-built rotations (D15). Values transcribed from the FAO-56 online tables; midpoints are used where a table prints a range.

profile.name: Sunflower

kc_ini.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Oil crops group Kc ini 0.35 (row blank)
kc_ini.region_relevance: Generic; Table 12 footnote 1: depends on wetting interval (FAO-56 Fig. 29/30, Annex 7)

kc_mid.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Sunflower Kc mid 1.0-1.15 (midpoint used; footnote 9: the lower value suits rainfed, less dense stands)
kc_mid.region_relevance: Sub-humid reference climate (RHmin 45%, u2 2 m/s); adjusted with FAO-56 eq. 62 at run time

kc_end.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Sunflower Kc end 0.35
kc_end.region_relevance: Sub-humid reference climate; adjusted with FAO-56 eq. 65 when Kc end > 0.45

ini.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 11, Sunflower, April/May planting, 'Medit.; California' row (25/35/45/25, total 130) (ini)
ini.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only; varies with region, climate and variety

dev.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 11, Sunflower, April/May planting, 'Medit.; California' row (25/35/45/25, total 130) (dev)
dev.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only; varies with region, climate and variety

mid.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 11, Sunflower, April/May planting, 'Medit.; California' row (25/35/45/25, total 130) (mid)
mid.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only; varies with region, climate and variety

late.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 11, Sunflower, April/May planting, 'Medit.; California' row (25/35/45/25, total 130) (late)
late.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only; varies with region, climate and variety

max_root_depth_m.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 22, Sunflower: Zr 0.8-1.5 m
max_root_depth_m.region_relevance: Larger value for modelling soil water stress (Table 22 footnote 1)

depletion_fraction_p.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 22, Sunflower: p 0.45
depletion_fraction_p.region_relevance: Generic; p = p_table + 0.04(5 - ETc) at run time (Table 22 footnote 2)

ky_season.reference: FAO-56 Chapter 8 Table 24 'Seasonal yield response functions from FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 33' (Doorenbos & Kassam 1979), value 0.95
ky_season.region_relevance: Generic; applied to the whole growing period, water-limited yield only
ky_season.uncertainty: Seasonal Ky only (stage-specific values are not in Table 24); varies with variety and climate

profile.traits_reference: USDA PLANTS Database (plants.usda.gov), family of Helianthus annuus; legume nitrogen fixation: Mohler & Johnson (2009) Crop Rotation on Organic Farms: A Planning Manual, SARE/NRAES-177

t_base_c.reference: FAO AquaCrop default crop file via AquaCrop-OSPy crop_params.py (Apache-2.0, github.com/aquacropos/aquacrop), 'Sunflower' Tbase 4.0 degC
t_base_c.region_relevance: Generic AquaCrop default (calibrated on other sites)
t_base_c.uncertainty: Not varietal; cultivars differ by a few degrees

max_height_m.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Sunflower h 2.0 m
